entities.summary: Maria Rosa Ferrer Obiols GOIH LH, was an Andorran lawyer and politician. She was the Cònsol Major of the Comú d'Andorra la Vella from 2007 until 2015 and the Minister of Health, Welfare and Employment of the Principality of Andorra until 4 January 2016.
